title: 935. Bag of Tokens

examples.explanation: Two cheap wins peak the score at 2.
Nothing affordable, no points to trade.

hints: Sort the tokens so the cheapest wins and the richest refuels are easy to pick.
Always spend the cheapest affordable token face-up; only when stuck, cash in the priciest remaining token face-down.
Record the best score seen, since late trades can dip before climbing again.
